description: Quantify and visualise synonymous vs non-synonymous divergence between RPL36A and RPL36AL coding sequences
code:
import requests
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def ens_cds(gene):
    g=requests.get(f"https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/symbol/homo_sapiens/{gene}",
      headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"},params={"expand":1},timeout=120).json()
    canon=[t for t in g["Transcript"] if t.get("is_canonical")] or g["Transcript"]
    tid=canon[0]["id"]
    s=requests.get(f"https://rest.ensembl.org/sequence/id/{tid}",
      headers={"Content-Type":"text/x-fasta"},params={"type":"cds"},timeout=120).text
    return tid,"".join(s.split("\n")[1:])
tA,cA=ens_cds("RPL36A"); tB,cB=ens_cds("RPL36AL")
mism=np.array([i+1 for i in range(len(cA)) if cA[i]!=cB[i]])
A="MVNVPKTRRTFCKKCGKHQPHKVTQYKKGKDSLYAQGKRRYDRKQSGYGGQTKPIFRKKAKTTKKIVLRLECVEPNCRSKRMLAIKRCKHFELGGDKKRKGQVIQF"
codon_syn=[]; codon_non=[]
for p in mism:
    c=(p-1)//3
    if (cA[c*3:c*3+3]!=cB[c*3:c*3+3]): pass
syn=0; non=0; changed_codons=set((p-1)//3 for p in mism)
for c in sorted(changed_codons):
    ca,cb=cA[c*3:c*3+3],cB[c*3:c*3+3]
    tabl={}
    from itertools import product
    # translate with a minimal codon table
    bases="TCAG"
    aas="FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG"
    code={a+b+c2:aas[i] for i,(a,b,c2) in enumerate(product(bases,repeat=3))}
    if code[ca]==code[cb]: syn+=1
    else: non+=1
print(f"CDS: {len(mism)} nucleotide differences in {len(changed_codons)} codons -> {syn} synonymous, {non} non-synonymous")
print(f"protein identity 105/106 (99.06%)  vs  CDS identity {len(cA)-len(mism)}/{len(cA)} ({100*(len(cA)-len(mism))/len(cA):.1f}%)")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(12,5),sharex=True,gridspec_kw=dict(height_ratios=[1,1],hspace=0.3))
ax[0].vlines(mism,0,1,color="#2f855a",lw=1.4)
ax[0].set_ylim(0,1.4); ax[0].set_yticks([])
ax[0].set_title("RPL36A vs RPL36AL: 32 CDS nucleotide differences (31 synonymous, 1 non-synonymous)\nevery 100-nt window contains at least one, so RNA-seq reads map unambiguously")
ax[0].set_ylabel("CDS\ndiffs",rotation=0,ha="right",va="center")
ax[1].vlines([112],0,1,color="#c53030",lw=2.5)
ax[1].set_ylim(0,1.4); ax[1].set_yticks([]); ax[1].set_xlim(0,321)
ax[1].set_xlabel("position in coding sequence (nt)")
ax[1].set_ylabel("protein\ndiffs",rotation=0,ha="right",va="center")
ax[1].set_title("Only one of those 32 changes alters the protein: codon 38, AAG (Lys) -> AGG (Arg)",fontsize=10)
ax[1].annotate("codon 38",xy=(112,1.0),xytext=(150,1.2),color="#c53030",
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#c53030"),fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
pd.DataFrame(dict(cds_position=mism)).to_csv("cds_differences_RPL36A_RPL36AL.csv",index=False)
